messages:
Nora (Design): Quick design sync — Settings > Privacy & security. Two small recurring issues from research: the encryption badge abbreviations confuse customers, and audit entries show raw internal keys that look scary. Can we make the UI friendlier without changing backend fields?

Ben (Frontend): Yep — post current copy? IIRC we show pills: `BYOK` and `US`. Audit lines are like `kms.rotate id=abc user=nora`.

Katrina (PM): Support reports customers interpret `US` as permanent data residency. We need copy that disambiguates processing vs storage. Also several customers asked explicitly "what does BYOK mean?"

Owen (a11y): Accessibility checklist: pills must expand abbreviations to screen readers (prefer `aria-label="Customer-managed key (BYOK)"`). Tooltips need to be keyboard-focusable and have `role="tooltip"` or tied via `aria-describedby`. Avoid putting important info only in hover text.

Marta (Security): Security requirement: external UI should use the phrase `Customer-managed key (BYOK)` or `Redwood managed key`. Audit logs must retain structured fields but UI can present a human-friendly message. Add `key_owner=customer` to audit metadata for BYOK ops.

Nora (Design): Proposed strings — vote or edit: 
- Pill (desktop): `Customer-managed key (BYOK)`
- Pill (mobile): `Customer key` (with tooltip `Customer-managed key (BYOK)`)
- Region pill: `Processing region: United States` (append ` (default)` when applicable)
- Tooltip (cust key): `You provide the encryption key material. Redwood stores only key references and cannot decrypt your data without your key.`
- Audit UI humanized message example:
```
Key rotated — Customer-managed key (BYOK). Performed by Nora (nora@example.com)
```
Keep raw fields in expandable JSON.

Ben (Frontend): Implementation notes: render the human message in the UI and include a small chevron to expand raw payload. For pills I'll truncate on narrow widths and show full text on focus/hover. Use non-breaking hyphen in `Customer\u2011managed` to avoid awkward wraps.

Katrina (PM): Also, retention wording: current header is `Data retention (days)` which some find technical. Suggest `Retention period` with numeric chips: `7 days`, `30 days (default)`, `90 days`, `Custom`. Add single-line subtext: `Applies to logs, exports, and transient telemetry.`

Owen (a11y): For the `30 days (default)` chip, set `aria-label="30 days, default"` so SRs speak naturally. Ensure chips are keyboard-operable (role=option or button) and announce state.

Marta (Security): Audit CSV exports: many customers parse headers. Changing headers breaks integrations. Proposal: keep machine headers (evt_ts, evt_type, actor, payload) and add a top-line `human_headers` comment row that maps them to friendly names. Example in CSV: 
```
# human_headers: Event time (ISO8601), Event type, Actor, Details
evt_ts,evt_type,actor,payload
2026-01-14T12:02:34Z,kms.key.rotate,nora@example.com,"Key rotated, key_id=abc123"
```
This preserves parsers and helps quick review.

Ben (Frontend): We'll implement UI changes only; CSV change needs ops approval. Leaving a note: change to audit message format requires coord with ops and SIEM owners.

log-bot: Heads up: audit message changes may affect existing log parsers. Ticket OPEN: OPS-2217 created.

Nora (Design): Final copy I'm pushing to Figma now: header `Retention period`; subtext `How long generated data (logs, audit events, and exports) is retained.` Presets: `7 days`, `30 days (default)`, `90 days`, `Custom...`. Pills: `Customer-managed key (BYOK)` / `Customer key` mobile; region pill `Processing region: <region>` with ` (default)` when needed. Tooltips per Marta's wording.

Marta (Security): Approved. Add audit metadata `key_owner=customer` and include the parenthetical `(cryptographic material handled by customer)` in the human UI message for BYOK rotates so SOC can filter quickly.

Owen (a11y): I'll produce a short QA checklist for tooltips, pills, and chips (keyboard focus, announcements, Esc to close). Will post on OPS-2217.

Ben (Frontend): I'll send a tiny PR for pill truncation, tooltip accessibility, and the audit-message display with expandable raw JSON. ETA: 3 days.

Katrina (PM): Actions: Nora finalize text in Figma, Ben PR, Owen a11y QA, Marta ops/SOC confirmation, ops to triage OPS-2217. Deadline: EOD next Tuesday.

Nora (Design): Thanks all — :thumbsup: closing once OPS-2217 has PR + docs links.
